From 70998c5c67ddd08af458f0f29aa5830a0729a0c0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Derek Bruening <bruening@google.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2018 01:05:48 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] i#975 static DR: fix Mac build (#2856)

Fixes a Mac build error introduced by 3bc33154.
Fixes a Mac test build error that shows up on newer toolchains.

Issue: #975

diff --git a/core/unix/module.c b/core/unix/module.c
index 91865b744..e4c635e43 100644
--- a/core/unix/module.c
+++ b/core/unix/module.c
@@ -33,8 +33,8 @@
  */
 
 #include "../globals.h"
-#include "module_private.h"
 #include "../module_shared.h"
+#include "module_private.h"
 #include "os_private.h"
 #include "../utils.h"
 #include "instrument.h"

diff --git a/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c b/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
index a71f043da..f5cffd684 100644
--- a/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
+++ b/suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 /* **********************************************************
- * Copyright (c) 2017 Google, Inc.  All rights reserved.
+ * Copyright (c) 2017-2018 Google, Inc.  All rights reserved.
  * **********************************************************/
 
 /*
@@ -90,9 +90,10 @@ GLOBAL_LABEL(FUNCNAME:)
         mov      REG_XDI, REG_XBP
         sub      REG_XDI, 12
         mov      [REG_XBP - 80], REG_XBP
-        jmp      test
+        /* We can't use "test" as a label on Mac NASM. */
+        jmp      test_start
 
-     test:
+     test_start:
         mov      REG_XCX, [REG_XDI + 12]
         mov      REG_XDX, [REG_XBP - 72]
         mov      REG_XBX, [REG_XBP - 80]
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `core/unix/module.c`**
   - The include directive for `"module_private.h"` was moved from below to above the include for `"module_shared.h"`. This change likely resolves a dependency issue that was causing build errors on Mac.

2. **File: `suite/tests/client-interface/memval-test.c`**
   - The copyright year was updated from "2017" to "2017-2018".
   - The label `test` was renamed to `test_start` to avoid conflicts with the label name on Mac NASM, which is not allowed. The jump instruction was updated accordingly.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `module.c` address a build error related to the order of includes, which is crucial for resolving dependencies in the code. This change is necessary for the overall build process to succeed on Mac systems. 

In `memval-test.c`, the changes are focused on ensuring compatibility with Mac NASM by renaming a label that could cause conflicts. This modification is related to the broader goal of making the codebase compatible with newer toolchains on Mac, as indicated by the patch's purpose to fix build errors. 

Both modifications are part of the same effort to enhance compatibility and resolve build issues on Mac systems, ensuring that the code can be compiled and tested successfully across different environments.
